# Norway

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Bits AS

**Role:** Norwegian banking infrastructure/standards body

**Reporting coverage:** National CAMT053/054 MIGs

**Messages / versions:** camt.053.001.08; camt.054.001.08; camt.055.001.08; camt.029.001.09; pain.001.001.09; pain.002.001.10

- [ISO 20022 national specification overview](https://bits.no/bank/iso-20022/) — specification; public-page
- [Bits Standards MIG portal](https://www.bits-standards.org/) — portal; linked-unverified

Bits maintains Norwegian message specifications and lists current CAMT053/054 v8. The overview states that Norwegian banks cover nationally defined cash-management messages. Circular 12/22 describes migration from 2009 to 2019 base messages; MIG version 2.0 differs from namespace version 08.
